limitations: Scripted policies are deterministic probes, not human playtests or guarantees about player outcomes.
The two levels can consume random draws differently, so a shared seed is not an identical-demand replay.
Fixed-horizon metrics freeze after an earlier ending and report alive=false.
All workers automatically work when usable capacity exists; scripted transfer policies cannot choose to leave workers idle.

Opening completion ceilings stack the starting workers in one column, exclude later recruitment, and assume uninterrupted fresh tasks and omit reaction time, unattended decay, dependencies, and admission delays.

averagePending and averageWork use approximate left-endpoint time integrals. WIP/backlog/satisfaction peaks and unlock times are sampled at decision boundaries. Final and fixed-horizon counts are exact.
